reviews.review: Warframe offers hundreds of hours of content and playability for absolutely nothing. While most major game devs insist on charging you money before you even get to touch their game Warframe is completely the opposite. If and when you would like to spend some money to support the devs or get something neat or shiny theres plenty of options but if you truly want something in the game but you dont want to pay for it well it may take quite some time or effort but everything is obtainable within the game without paying a cent and that is pretty amazing imo.

theres this kid that plays waframe whos name is garrett. Because he plays this game, it already makes it a 2/10. Overall, pretty good game. Also, garrett has a cousin who enjoys collecting things instead of advancing in the mission with the others. Therefore, 3/10.

Pros:
+ Great graphics, especially for a F2P MMO.
+ Fun gunplay and abilities.
+ Very fluid movement.
+ A large variety of different frames, weapons, mods, and playstyles are available. This allows for massive amounts of customization in how you play.
+ Fashion is on point in Warframe. Even basic frames look pretty dope.
+ Story is okay, not great, but it's a solid attempt. Everyone is fully voice acted (besides the Warframes, who are silent).
+ There's a lot of stuff to collect. Many weapons and frames have Prime versions which are harder to obtain, but have slightly increased stats (and they just look cooler). Plus, there's a lot of rare mods as well. Completionists will have their work cut out for them.
+ Dope sound effects.
+ The music is okay.
+ The game is NOT P2W. AT ALL. Almost everything can be obtained for free, besides some cosmetics that you can only buy through Steam.
+ This game has so much content that it makes AAA games look bad. Seriously.
+ The community is not THAT toxic. Most people will be relatively helpful and nice. Although if you take forever getting to extraction, don't play the objective, constantly die, or are a bad Limbo, then you'll probably get flamed.

Cons:
- The new player experience is sub par. Not a whole lot is explained besides basic controls and your orbiter's functionality. You'll end up looking to the wiki for a lot of your information. Also, it takes a while to actually start getting new frames. You're stuck with Excalibur (let's be honest, you picked Excalibur over Volt and Mag) for a HOT minute (we're talking 5 days minimum, depending on how quickly you grind). It's to the point where I actually recommend buying some frames when you first start out, that way you don't get bored playing with the same frame over and over.
- Why does crafting take so f*cking long? Like seriously, I don't see any point in making your foundry take THREE DAYS to craft a new frame. THREE. DAYS. Like, is this a mobile game??? Most stuff takes at least 12 hours to craft. I just don't understand why this is a thing. Not only do you have to grind blueprints and resources (which takes a while depending on what you're trying to build and how lucky you are), but then you have to wait 12-72 hours for your item to be built? What?
- Get. Rid. Of. The. F*CKING. CYST. IT IS A MASSIVE EYESORE. In a game where fashion is kinda important, why do you forcefully put this giant PINK CYST on my neck, and force me to wait 7 days PER FRAME to get it removed? WHY? Why can't I remove it now? Why do I have to wait a whole f*cking WEEK to get it taken off? A WEEK. 7 DAYS. PER FRAME.

+/- The game is grindy and repetitive by nature. I can't completely call that a pro or con, because some people hate grinding, others don't mind it. Make your own call.
+/- Warframe is 99% PvE. There's like 6 people who play the game's PvP, because it's just not good. It doesn't work, even in theory. The way that gunplay and abilities function just doesn't really allow for an enjoyable PvP experience. Again, I don't mind because PvP isn't my thing, but some may be disappointed by this.
